summary: Exact candidate 49a136764025c3a0ac76b2105884bbf is a valid partial correction: it enables safe decode-prefix Mamba eviction by default and retains admission-safe pool ratios. Its deterministic regression fails on the recorded base and passes on the candidate. It does not verify or guarantee scheduler/HTTP bounded progress under an unreclaimable Mamba allocation and does not reproduce the production hierarchical-cache stall, so it cannot be accepted as a full original-issue fix.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before: 10 tests ran; default decode unlock was false and the enabled lazy-buffer ratio was 3 rather than the admission-safe 4. The same fixture also exercised the locked-prefix 2N exhaustion counterexample.
10 focused tests passed, covering default decode unlock, both environment-switch ratio modes, locked-prefix 2N failure, 3N success, evictable-prefix 2N recovery, lock-release symmetry, and PP sizing.
8 configured request/token boundary tests passed; these do not exercise HTTP responsiveness or event-loop progress under Mamba allocation pressure.

gpu_execution.evidence: Review tests were deterministic CPU-side cache/accounting tests. The available ROCm environment cannot qualify the reported H100 TP=8 CUDA workload, and compatible Qwen3.5 weights were unavailable.

remaining_limitations: Available architecture is ROCm 7.2 with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, not eight H100 80GB GPUs; TP=8, CUDA, EAGLE, production-scale traffic, and model semantics were not tested.
Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 weights and the reported direct hierarchical-cache I/O setup were unavailable.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
The tiny Llama transport fixture cannot exercise hybrid-Mamba allocation and would not qualify this issue contract.
remaining_counterexamples: An admission whose Mamba slot remains unreclaimable has no demonstrated bounded scheduler progress or graceful fail-fast handling; the focused allocator test expects an assertion.
No regression proves /health or completion handling remains responsive while Mamba admission cannot make progress.
The zero-running post-flush exhaustion case is neither reproduced nor explained.
Direct hierarchical-cache I/O blocking and the reported 222-second TTFT remain untested.
The original Qwen3.5 hybrid-Mamba TP=8 H100 workload remains unverified.
